name: rag_specialty_qa_v1
description: Deterministic retrieval eval for the Waypoint specialty-knowledge lane (RAGAS-inspired: retrieval hit-rate + negative rejection; faithfulness is enforced by the grounding evaluator's overlap guard). Positive queries must surface the expected niche as the TOP hit through the serving seam (SpecialtyKnowledgeService.identify_niche); negative queries must return no niche at all. Designed against the hash lane; the semantic lane runs the same corpus via tools/rag_eval.py --semantic.
